name: SDN PNM Publication History Flow
description: HTTP PNM-provenance flow (gateway loop G.3): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route discover emits the routing decision (pnm_history with peerId + in-wasm clamped limit [1,100] default 1 | not_found), hostcap/p2p-discovery pnm_history issues the policy-mediated p2p.pnm_history hostcall (the peer's stored signed $PNM publications, publisher-attributed by Ed25519 SIGNATURE on the host because the store's recorded peer id is only the gossip-delivering peer; short-circuited on not_found) and re-emits the decision, foundation/discovery-shape shape_pnm splices the signed $PNM frames VERBATIM (signatures intact) newest-first / encodes the bare-array json presentation with the signature_verified/attribution provenance fields and the shared FNV-1a etag / rewrites empty histories to not_found, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is the declared p2p_read hostcall.

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host discovery snapshots (peerstore + DHT + EPM registry + stored PNMs).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP request envelope ($HTQ, module-sdk schemas/HttpRequestAbi.fbs).

inputPorts.description: One HTTP request envelope as delivered verbatim by the host pipe.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR, module-sdk schemas/HttpResponseAbi.fbs): STATUS, HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY. The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one HTTP response envelope per invoke.
